- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Propose 8 diverse candidate hypotheses.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}

Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: A shopper must take the entry cart from the cart station before leaving the store.
Items may only be picked up while the shopper is pushing the cart.
A shopper must not carry merchandise by hand.
After taking the entry cart, the shopper must return it to the north-west return bay before the trip ends.
The cart may only be put down at the designated north-west return bay.
A shopper may exit only after the cart has been parked at the north-west return bay.
Except for the initial step toward the cart, a shopper must not move around the store without the cart until it has been returned.
The special interaction at the north-west bay must be returning the cart, not picking up an item or another interaction.

accepted.description: [g1_use_entry_cart] OBLIGED: after start, eventually entry_cart_taken (before exit)  where entry_cart_station := (at(1,5) ∧ cartAt(1,5)); entry_cart_taken := (entry_cart_station ∧ PICKUP_CART) · hasCart
[g1_no_pickup_without_cart] FORBIDDEN: cartless_item_pickup  where cartless := ¬hasCart; cartless_item_pickup := (cartless ∧ PICKUP_ITEM)
[g1_no_hand_carrying] FORBIDDEN: carrying_by_hand  where carrying_by_hand := handFull; hand_item_acquired := (¬hasCart ∧ PICKUP_ITEM) · handFull

[g1_return_cart_northwest] OBLIGED: after entry_cart_taken, eventually northwest_cart_returned (before exit)  where cart_parked_northwest := cartAt(0,1); entry_cart_station := (at(1,5) ∧ cartAt(1,5)); northwest_return_bay := at(0,1); entry_cart_taken := (entry_cart_station ∧ PICKUP_CART) · hasCart; northwest_cart_returned := (northwest_return_bay ∧ hasCart ∧ LEAVE_CART) · cart_parked_northwest

[g1_leave_cart_only_at_return_bay] FORBIDDEN: cart_left_elsewhere  where northwest_return_bay := at(0,1); outside_return_bay := ¬northwest_return_bay; cart_left_elsewhere := (LEAVE_CART ∧ outside_return_bay)

[g1_exit_after_cart_return] FORBIDDEN: exit_before_cart_return  where cart_not_parked_northwest := ¬cart_parked_northwest; cart_parked_northwest := cartAt(0,1); exit_before_cart_return := (EXIT ∧ cart_not_parked_northwest)

[g1_no_cartless_shopping_movement] FORBIDDEN: cartless_move_before_return  where cart_not_returned := ¬cartAt(0,1); cartless := ¬hasCart; cartless_before_return := (cartless ∧ cart_not_returned ∧ not_initial_start_cell); not_initial_start_cell := ¬at(0,5); cartless_move_before_return := (MOVE ∧ cartless_before_return)

[g1_northwest_interaction_is_cart_return] FORBIDDEN: nonreturn_interaction_at_northwest  where northwest_return_bay := at(0,1); nonreturn_interaction_at_northwest := (northwest_return_bay ∧ INTERACT ∧ ¬LEAVE_CART)
